units.source_text: 且说出家为僧的朱雀院，专心修行佛道，朝廷政治概不闻问。

en.t: Now Suzaku-in, who had taken holy orders and become a monk, devoted himself entirely to Buddhist practice and paid no attention at all to affairs of state.

units.source_text: 只在春秋二季今上行幸省亲之时，也还谈谈昔年旧事。

en.t: Only when the reigning emperor came in spring and autumn to visit his father did they speak a little of old times.

units.source_text: 就中关于三公主，他至今还不能放心。

en.t: Among all matters, he still could not set his mind at ease about the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他让源氏做她的正式的保护人，而教今上暗中照拂这皇妹。

en.t: He made Genji her official guardian and instructed the reigning emperor to look after this imperial sister quietly from behind the scenes.

units.source_text: 于是朝廷晋封三公主为二品，封户也增加不少，三公主的威势便更加显赫了。

en.t: The court therefore promoted the Third Princess to the second rank and greatly increased her allotted households, so her dignity and influence became still more splendid.

units.source_text: 紫夫人看见这几年来三公主的声望在各方面都日渐提高，常常想道：“我身单靠源氏主君一人的宠爱，始得不落人后。

en.t: Lady Murasaki saw that in recent years the Third Princess's standing had been rising in every respect, and she often thought, "I have managed not to fall behind others only because I rely on Lord Genji's affection for me alone.

units.source_text: 将来年纪老矣，这宠爱终当衰减。

en.t: When I grow old in the future, that affection is bound to fade at last.

units.source_text: 不如在未到此时以前，自己发心出家吧。”

en.t: Before that time comes, it would be better for me to resolve on my own to take holy orders."

units.source_text: 但恐源氏当她赌气，因此并不爽快说出。

en.t: But she feared that Genji would take it as a fit of resentment, and so she did not speak of it frankly.

units.source_text: 源氏看见主上也关心三公主，觉得不可怠慢了她，此后在她那里住宿的日子增多，三公主便与紫夫人平分秋色了。

en.t: Seeing that the emperor too was concerned for the Third Princess, Genji felt he could not neglect her, and after that he spent more nights at her rooms, so that she came to stand on equal footing with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 紫夫人认为这也是理之当然，但私心未免不安，觉得果然不出所料。

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought this was only natural, but in her private heart she could not help feeling uneasy and felt that things had turned out just as she had expected.

units.source_text: 然而表面上装作若无其事。

en.t: Outwardly, however, she pretended that nothing was wrong.

units.source_text: 她把明石女御所生长女，即皇太子以次的那个大公主，领到自己身边，用心抚育她。

en.t: She brought to her side the eldest daughter born to the Akashi Consort, the princess next after the crown prince, and raised her with great care.

units.source_text: 和这女孩作伴，可以慰藉孤眠之夜的寂寥。

en.t: Keeping this girl as her companion helped soothe the loneliness of nights spent sleeping alone.

units.source_text: 明石女御所生子女，她个个都很疼爱。

en.t: She dearly loved every one of the children born to the Akashi Consort.

units.source_text: 花散里夫人看见紫夫人有这许多孙儿，不胜艳羡，也把夕雾大将与惟光的女儿典侍所生的女儿迎了过来，抚养在身边。

en.t: Lady Hanachirusato, seeing Lady Murasaki with so many grandchildren, envied her greatly and also brought over the daughter born to General Yugiri and the Naishi who was Koremitsu's daughter, raising the child at her side.

units.source_text: 这女孩长得非常可爱，而且聪明伶俐，与年龄似不相称，因此源氏也很疼爱她。

en.t: This girl grew up exceedingly charming, and she was so clever and quick-witted that she seemed older than her years, so Genji too loved her dearly.

units.source_text: 源氏子女稀少，而第三代繁昌，各处孙儿甚多。

en.t: Genji had few children of his own, but the third generation flourished, and he had many grandchildren in various households.

units.source_text: 现在他就靠抚育孙儿，以慰寂寥。

en.t: Now he relied on raising his grandchildren to comfort his loneliness.

units.source_text: 髭黑右大臣常来探望，比以前更加亲近了。

en.t: Higekuro, the Minister of the Right, often came to visit and became even closer to him than before.

units.source_text: 他的夫人玉鬘现已变成少妇，大约因为她这义父已不像从前那样贪色了，故每逢适当机会，也常来六条院问候，与紫夫人会面，彼此十分亲睦。

en.t: His wife Tamakazura had now become a young matron, and perhaps because her adoptive father was no longer as amorous as before, she also came to Rokujo-in whenever the occasion was suitable, paid her respects, met with Lady Murasaki, and remained very friendly with her.

units.source_text: 只有三公主，虽然年已二十，还同儿时一样天真烂漫。

en.t: Only the Third Princess, though already twenty years old, was still as innocent and artless as she had been in childhood.

units.source_text: 源氏现在已将明石女御委托皇上照顾，自己就专心一意地照顾这三公主，像幼女一般疼爱她。

en.t: Genji had now entrusted the Akashi Consort to the emperor's care, and he himself devoted all his attention to looking after the Third Princess, cherishing her as though she were a little girl.
